mentions.name: Sunred
mentions.description: This app is an RSS reader with social features built on AT Protocol, letting users repost and star articles, with the goal of fixing the web and countering depressive social media.
mentions.problem: The web and existing social media have become depressive; this project tries to fix that.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made an RSS reader with social features based on AT Proto (repost articles / star them). Trying to fix the web and the depressive social medias.

https://sunred.app/
mentions.author: fuegoio
